name: Dinevenator
sum: Troodontid known from a nearly complete frontal bone from the Campanian Kirtland Formation of New Mexico, once classed as a dromaeosaurid.
wsnote: Known only from a frontal bone; no body size in the sources consulted.
holotype: SMP VP-1955, a left frontal bone from the De-na-zin Member of the Kirtland Formation, San Juan Basin, New Mexico.
biology: Only the skull roof is known; the sources consulted say nothing on its way of life.
author: Jasinski & Sullivan 2026
